source.name: UN Sustainable Development Goals
source.note: Target wording checked against several UN-derived pages. Target summaries are written in our own words.

method: Team mapping: each role is linked to the SDG target it most plausibly supports. Most links are indirect and are labelled so.

pathway_sdgs.target_summary: Increase the number of people with relevant skills for decent jobs.
pathway_sdgs.why: Following a reskilling plan builds skills that employers look for.

pathway_sdgs.target_summary: Achieve full and productive employment and decent work for all.
pathway_sdgs.why: Moving into a growing role supports productive employment and decent work.

data analyst.target_summary: Raise economic productivity through diversification, technology upgrading and innovation.
data analyst.why: Data analysis helps organisations use technology and evidence to raise productivity.

data scientist.target_summary: Raise economic productivity through diversification, technology upgrading and innovation.
data scientist.why: Data science is a core way organisations upgrade technology and innovate.

data quality specialist.target_summary: Increase the availability of high-quality, timely and reliable data.
data quality specialist.why: Checking and improving data quality supports the reliable data this target asks for.

data protection officer.target_summary: Build effective, accountable and transparent institutions.
data protection officer.why: Protecting personal data helps organisations stay accountable and transparent.

market research analyst.target_summary: Support productive activity, decent job creation, entrepreneurship and the growth of small and medium businesses, including their access to finance.
market research analyst.why: Market research helps small and medium businesses find customers and grow.

digital marketing manager.target_summary: Support productive activity, decent job creation, entrepreneurship and the growth of small and medium businesses, including their access to finance.
digital marketing manager.why: Digital marketing helps small and medium businesses reach customers and grow.

client relations manager.target_summary: Support productive activity, decent job creation, entrepreneurship and the growth of small and medium businesses, including their access to finance.
client relations manager.why: Strong client relationships help businesses keep customers and create stable jobs.

customer experience manager.target_summary: Raise economic productivity through diversification, technology upgrading and innovation.
customer experience manager.why: Better customer experience raises service quality and productivity through innovation.

financial analyst.target_summary: Strengthen national financial institutions so more people can use banking, financial and insurance services.
financial analyst.why: Financial analysis supports institutions that offer financial services to more people.

financial controller.target_summary: Build effective, accountable and transparent institutions.
financial controller.why: Financial control and reporting help organisations stay accountable and transparent.
